meta_description:
shivya on September 24, 2026: "I’ve been living and slow travelling in Europe for almost a year, and have picked up lots of ways to keep my costs and footprint low! 

Do you dream of slow travelling in Europe too? Ask me your questions👇🏽

Big thank you @europeansleeper for inviting me on the Good Night Train, and letting me reflect on all the things that’ve enabled my slow adventures 💚

PS: The Good Night Train also connects Paris, Cologne and Milan 🚃".
